ruleDefinitions.name: Possible Privilege Escalation via Weak Service Permissions
ruleDefinitions.description: Detection of sc.exe utility spawning by user with Medium integrity level to change service ImagePath or FailureCommand

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\\\sc\\\.exe$") AND (process_integrity_level = "Medium" OR process_integrity_level = "S\-1\-16\-8192")) AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*config.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*binPath.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*failure.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*command.*")))
